Plot a wsva_fit

Source: R/fit_methods.R
plot.wsva_fit.Rd

Plot a wsva_fit

Usage

# S3 method for class 'wsva_fit'
plot(
  x,
  type = c("overview", "hydrograph", "fdc", "seasonal", "annual", "skill", "contrast",
    "params"),
  years = 2,
  log = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A wsva_fit.

type

"overview" (hydrographs, flow duration, seasonal cycle, annual flow), or one of "hydrograph", "fdc", "seasonal", "annual", "skill", "contrast", "params".

years

Recent water years in the hydrograph.

log

Log-scale hydrograph.

...

Unused.

Value

A ggplot (or a patchwork for "overview").
